flags.why: The colloquial expression describes or intensifies misery or a dreadful state, rather than meaning freezing cold, as illustrated in [Kiệt Tấn's usage](https://www.talawas.org/talaDB/showFile.php?rb=0204&res=14114).
The example incorrectly uses the expression as an ordinary description of cold weather.
flags.fix: Anh ấy nghèo tàn canh gió lạnh. = He is desperately poor.

flags.why: This sense denotes a stopping passenger train, not a bus or any local transport service, according to the [Vietnamese dictionary definition](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/tau-cho-e2tMwq7Y0yfxF.html).
flags.fix: local passenger train that stops at most stations

flags.why: The example defines the word instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Chiếc tàu tuần dương đang tuần tra ngoài khơi. = The cruiser is patrolling offshore.
